score.note: The second 080bbb0c transfer pass corrected the result carrier to its promoted register width, made target-id 9 an explicit exceptional remap, and removed the cached range carrier so both multi-target tests independently reload the byte field. A phase audit then caught the inverse width on the runtime destination: the local carrier is promoted s32, but the runtime field is a halfword. Restoring that evidence-backed pairing preserves exact owner length and lowers the residual to 437 differing halfwords and 412 wrong instructions.

notes: The complete retained assembly and assembled listing were read; pools resolve Data_03001f2c and runtime offsets 0x219/0x25a, while the target list begins at 0x208.
BattleAction field names and the max_hp/max_pp/hp/pp/poison vocabulary are inherited only where exact local layouts coincide; the unresolved early BattleUnit fields remain in an owner-local view.

The retained lookup branch reduced the 564-halfword baseline to 557; the damage-class branch and indexed stat access reduced it to 539; direct raw-field access in the two follow-up cases then reduced it to 487.

Removing the primary HP raw carriers was linked-score neutral at 539 but removed two wrong instructions and enabled the later follow-up lifetime improvements; primary PP deliberately retains its carriers because removing them re-enters the 581-halfword allocation family.
Changing result_code to its promoted s32 lifetime reduced the linked residual by 13 halfwords without altering behavior; the runtime store remains halfword-wide.

Expressing target-id 9 as a zero-default exceptional remap reduced wrong instructions by eight, and independently reloading effect->range at both multi-target decisions removed another twelve wrong instructions while restoring the exact 1336-byte owner length.

The second-pass target-sequence partition measured 189 nonexact target instructions in the primary switch, 156 in the follow-up switch, 30 in the tail, and 22 in entry/selection. Correcting the runtime result destination back to its evidenced halfword width while retaining the promoted local carrier reduced the linked residual by another 35 halfwords and 12 wrong instructions.
No inline assembly, fixed-register variables, compiler barriers, copied instruction bytes, compiler changes, or nonlocal evidence were used.
This is a measured draft only; retained reference assembly remains authoritative.
